name: Calcular el salario de un empleado en el centro de atencion al cliente
untr_name: Calculating the Wage of an Employee at the Customer Service Call Center
description: Construya un programa para el departamento de pagos de una empresa que calcule el salario de un empleado que trabaja en el centro de atencion al cliente. Al igual que otros empleados de la empresa, los empleados del centro de atencion al cliente reciben pago en funcion de las horas que trabajan. Si trabajan mas de 40 horas en una semana, el importe del pago debe tener en cuenta las horas extra. Las horas extra se pagan a una tasa de una vez y media la tarifa regular.\nLa politica de la empresa es pagar mas a aquellos empleados del centro de atencion al cliente que trabajan durante los fines de semana. Por lo tanto, el pago extra minimo que los empleados podrian recibir por cada dia de trabajo durante fines de semana es de $30. El pago extra aumenta hasta un maximo de $50 para los empleados que tienen al menos 5 dias de trabajo durante fines de semana.
untr_description: Construct a program for the payment department of a company to calculate the wage of an employee who works at the customer service call center. Like other employees in the company, the employees at the customer service call center are paid based on the hours that they work. If they work over 40 hours in a week, the payment amount should take into account the overtime hours. The overtime hours are paid at a rate one and a half times the regular pay rate.\nThe company's policy is to pay more to those employees at the customer service call center who work during weekends. Therefore, the minimum extra pay that the employees could receive for each day of work during weekends is $30. The extra pay increases to the maximum of $50 for the employees who have at least 5 days of work during weekends.
code:
#Paso 1: Asignar valores iniciales a las variables que necesitamos para este programa
rate = 8.25 
standard = 40 
weekend_pay_min = 30 
weekend_pay_max = 50 
#Paso 2: Leer los datos de entrada
text = input("Ingrese el numero de horas que el empleado ha trabajado: ")
hours = int(text)
text = input("Ingrese el numero de dias que el empleado ha trabajado durante fines de semana: ")
no_weekend_days = int(text)
#Paso 3: Pagar horas extra a tiempo y medio de la tarifa regular
if hours > standard :
    wage = standard * rate + ( hours-standard ) * ( rate * 1.5 )
else :
    wage = hours * rate
#Paso 4: Tomar en cuenta el pago extra por el trabajo durante los dias de fin de semana
if no_weekend_days < 5 :
    wage += (no_weekend_days * weekend_pay_min)
else :
    wage += (no_weekend_days * weekend_pay_max)
#Paso 5: Imprimir el salario calculado
print("Salario:", wage)

#Step 1: Assign initial values to the variables which we need for this program

weekend_pay_max = 50 
#Step 2: Read the input data

text = input("Enter the number of days that the employee has worked during weekends: ")
no_weekend_days = int(text)
#Step 3: Pay overtime at "time and a half" of the regular rate of pay
if hours > standard :
    wage = standard * rate + ( hours-standard ) * ( rate * 1.5 )
else :
    wage = hours * rate
#Step 4: Take into account the extra pay for the work during weekends days
if no_weekend_days < 5 :
    wage += (no_weekend_days * weekend_pay_min)
else :
    wage += (no_weekend_days * weekend_pay_max)
#Step 5: Print the calculated wage
print("Wage:", wage)

11.content: #Step 3: Pay overtime at "time and a half" of the regular rate of pay

comments.content: Para determinar si debemos pagar horas extra al empleado, necesitamos comprobar si el empleado ha trabajado mas de las horas estandar en una semana laboral. Si el empleado ha trabajado mas de las horas estandar en una semana laboral, entonces el pago debe tener en cuenta las horas extra y debemos pagar las horas extra a "tiempo y medio" de la tarifa regular. En caso contrario, pagamos al empleado en funcion del numero de horas que ha trabajado y la tarifa de pago regular.
comments.untr_content: To determine whether we should pay overtime to the employee, we need to test whether the employee has worked more than the standard hours in a work week. If the employee has worked more than the standard hours in a work week, then the payment should take into account the overtime hours and we need to pay overtime at "time and a half" of the regular rate of pay. Otherwise, we pay the employee based on the number of hours that the employee has worked and the regular pay rate.

comments.content: La sentencia if prueba si el numero de horas introducido por el usuario es mayor que las horas estandar en una semana laboral. Si el numero de horas es mayor que las horas estandar en una semana laboral, entonces se ejecuta el cuerpo de esta sentencia if. En caso contrario, el cuerpo de esta sentencia if se omite.
comments.untr_content: The if statement tests whether the number of hours entered by the user is greater than the standard hours in a work week. If the number of hours is greater than the standard hours in a work week, then the body of this if statement gets executed. Otherwise, the body of this if statement is skipped.

comments.content:
Cuando el numero de horas es mayor que las horas estandar en una semana laboral, debemos pagar al empleado por las horas estandar de la semana laboral mas las horas extra que el empleado haya trabajado.

Las horas estandar en una semana laboral se pagan a la tarifa regular. Las horas extra se pagan a una tarifa una vez y media la tarifa regular. Por lo tanto, la tarifa de horas extra del empleado es la tarifa regular multiplicada por 1.5.
comments.untr_content:
When the number of hours is greater than the standard hours in a work week, we need to pay the employee for the standard hours in a work week plus the overtime hours that the employee has worked.

The standard hours in a work week are paid at a regular pay rate. The overtime hours are paid at a rate one and a half times the regular pay rate. Therefore, the employee’s overtime rate of pay is the regular pay rate multiplied by 1.5.

comments.content: Si la prueba if anterior falla (es decir, cuando el empleado ha trabajado menos o igual que las horas estandar en una semana laboral), debemos calcular el salario en funcion del numero de horas que el empleado ha trabajado y la tarifa de pago regular.
comments.untr_content: If the above if test fails (i.e., when the employee has worked less than or equal to the standard hours in a work week), we should calculate the wage based on the number of hours that the employee has worked and the regular pay rate.

comments.untr_content: The statement inside the body of this else statement is executed when the if condition is false, i.e., the number of hours is less than or equal to the standard hours in a work week. Otherwise, the body of this else statement is skipped.
